verdict.rationale: Mercury documents a dedicated sandbox with its own signup and its own API and OAuth2 base URLs (api-sandbox.mercury.com, oauth2-sandbox.mercury.com). The sandbox comes pre-loaded with dummy organizations, accounts, transactions and balances, involves no real money, rejects production tokens, and the marketing site says moving to production means swapping one URL. Missing for 10: no independent or hands-on corroboration of the sandbox, and no evidence the MCP server or CLI (the agent-facing surfaces) can be pointed at the sandbox.
